{"feature": "standard_meter_can",
 "evidence": "Photo 11 shows the electric meter mounted on the cream siding near the house corner. All four edges of the enclosure are visible. It is a small rectangular socket only slightly larger than the round meter, spanning about three siding courses, with a conduit running down from the bottom. No other photo shows the electric meter; photos 2–4 show the gas meter.",
 "notes": "The enclosure is compact and sized closely to the meter, with no extended height or width of the kind a large 320A-style can would have.",
 "insufficientEvidence": false}

json.evidence: Photo 11 shows the electric meter mounted on the cream siding near the house corner. All four edges of the enclosure are visible. It is a small rectangular socket only slightly larger than the round meter, spanning about three siding courses, with a conduit running down from the bottom. No other photo shows the electric meter; photos 2–4 show the gas meter.
json.notes: The enclosure is compact and sized closely to the meter, with no extended height or width of the kind a large 320A-style can would have.
